title: Synthetic KIS H0STCNT0 execution projection
attribution: Synthetic fixture authored by the WeaveTrail contributors from the cited published schema and rule documents.

syntheticity.values: Every value in this dialect is synthetic, including the business date, execution times, instrument, side selections, prices and quantities or volumes.
syntheticity.entities: ZZ79X1 is fictional and is not a six-digit domestic listing code. This dialect contains no account or participant column. No real issuer, customer, account, order or production system is represented.
syntheticity.marketData: No market data was requested, retrieved, committed, redistributed or used to calibrate or choose these values. The cited market rules are published rules, not data.

derivation.description: The committed JSON Lines file projects selected H0STCNT0 response-column names and code values over invented values. It copies no KIS response or market-data bytes.

derivation.actorDimension: Per-execution actor attribution is not published in any domestic source; no domestic source recorded by this repository supplies it. The RAPID_PRICE_LIFT rule treats actorId as an eligibility condition, so the participant dimension must remain synthetic and may not be inferred from H0STCNT0.

absentFields.reason: The published response-column list contains no participant or account field.
absentFields.workbenchHandling: The mapping proposal records actorId as absent and REVIEW_REQUIRED. A reviewer may acknowledge the absence, but the workbench does not copy, infer or synthesize an actor and will not run the participant-dependent rule over this dialect.

validation.environment: Node 22.18.0, pnpm 10.33.2, Vitest 4.1.11, Linux WSL2 x86_64
validation.capturedOutput: Parser rows, shared-field normalization, actor absence and fail-closed refusal are asserted. This dialect has no approved actor-dependent case result.
validation.limitations: This single deterministic synthetic dialect measures neither mapping quality nor detection performance. It cannot supply participant identity and does not produce a pattern verdict.
